best_idea: One visibility gate with a fixed precedence (staff, then ignore, then the owner's chat mode with unknown treated as off, then friends-only, then on) decides friend status and private-message reach, so a player's ignore and privacy settings work the same everywhere.
decision_why: Friends and private chat should share one gate for child-safety and blocking; the donor's gate is right in shape, but its PM path skips it and an invalid saved mode fails open to ON, which the child-safety default must not do.
acceptance: A server test: a PM from a player the owner ignores is not delivered; a player whose chat mode is OFF shows offline in friend lists and receives no PM; a saved chat mode outside 0..2 resolves to OFF.
